panel.title: Options for {{name}}
panel.subtitle: On {{computer}}
panel.footReloadWork: Saving reloads {{name}}. Save your work in it first.
panel.footLater: Saved options apply when {{name}} next opens.
panel.stale: Some saved options no longer apply and will be removed when you save.
preview.label: Terminal preview
preview.caption: Preview. The font must be installed on the device that shows the terminal.
sort.name: Name
ttheme.ansiBody: The colours programs use for their own text, such as red for errors.
ttheme.c.swatches: The swatches are this colour in the built-in themes.
ttheme.fixJson: Fix the theme JSON below to pick colours again.
ttheme.colourBad: A theme colour is not a colour: use a hex code such as #1E1E1E, or empty it
tfont.system.desc: The first of Consolas, Liberation Mono, Menlo or Courier this device has
term.cwd.label: Start in
term.cwd.help: New sessions start in this folder, given as a full path. It must already exist. A running session keeps its folder.
term.readonly.label: View only
term.readonly.help: Shows the output; typing is blocked. Default: the program decides.
term.title.label: Tab title
term.title.help: The browser tab's name when this terminal is opened on its own.
term.toolbar.label: Toolbar
term.toolbar.help: The bar above the terminal, with its own buttons. Default on a Board: off. The tile bar has the actions.
term.fontSize.label: Font size
term.fontFamily.label: Font
term.fontFamily.help: Shown only if the font is installed on that device. Otherwise the next one in the list is used.
term.lineHeight.label: Line height
term.lineHeight.help: A whole multiple of the font size (1 is normal, 2 is double).
term.letterSpacing.label: Letter spacing
term.theme.label: Theme
term.theme.help: Colours for text, background, cursor and the 16 terminal colours.
term.background.label: Background
term.bright.label: Bold in bright colours
term.bright.help: Bold text uses the brighter version of its colour. Default: the program decides.
term.cursorStyle.label: Shape
term.cursorBlink.label: Blink
term.cursorWidth.label: Bar width
term.cursorInactive.label: When not focused
term.cursorInactive.help: The cursor's shape while you work in another tile.
term.panel.label: Page
term.panel.help: A web page shown beside the terminal, such as your app's preview. Some browsers block sign-in details inside embedded pages.
term.panelVisible.label: Show on open
term.panelVisible.help: Otherwise the panel opens from the toolbar. Default: the program decides.
term.panelPosition.label: Position
term.panelWidthPct.label: Width
term.panelHeightPct.label: Height
term.panelResizable.label: Resizable
term.panelResizable.help: Drag its edge to resize. Default: the program decides.
term.scrollback.label: History
term.scrollSpeed.label: Scroll speed
term.fastScroll.label: Fast scroll speed
term.smooth.label: Smooth scrolling
term.screenReader.label: Screen reader support
term.screenReader.help: Makes the output readable by screen readers. Default: the program decides.
term.contrast.label: Minimum contrast
term.contrast.help: Colours change until text reaches this contrast. 1 changes nothing. 5 or more meets the common accessibility target.
term.fontWeight.label: Text weight
term.fontWeightBold.label: Bold weight
term.panelWidth.label: Panel width (pixels or %)
term.panelWidth.help: Used when the side panel's Width is not set.
term.panelHeight.label: Panel height (pixels or %)
term.panelHeight.help: Used when the side panel's Height is not set.
term.resizeBadge.label: Size badge while resizing
term.unicode.label: Character widths
term.unicode.help: Change only if emoji or wide characters line up wrongly.
term.renderer.label: Renderer
term.renderer.help: Automatic uses WebGL, or DOM in Firefox and on phones. Try DOM if text looks wrong.
display.quality.label: Quality
quality.smooth.desc: Best for video and animation. Text can look soft while things move.
quality.low.desc: For slow or metered connections (about 2 Mbit/s).
display.encoding.label: Encoding
display.encoding.help: WebP keeps text sharp. Auto may switch busy windows to video.
enc.auto.desc: The server chooses; busy windows may switch to video, which can look blurry.
display.video.label: Video
display.video.help: Allow video encodings. Default: the program decides.
display.bandwidth.label: Bandwidth limit
display.qualityMode.label: Image quality
display.qualityMode.help: Auto lowers quality while the connection is slow and needs Reconnect automatically. Best always uses full quality; Reduced always uses a lower one.
display.qualityFixed.label: Fixed quality
display.qualityFixed.help: 0 to 100. Wins over Image quality and hides that choice in the viewer's menu. PNG and RGB ignore it.
display.size.label: Desktop size
display.size.help: Fit the tile: follows the tile's width. Fixed: the display keeps this width in pixels, scaled to fit the tile.
display.maximize.label: New windows open maximised
display.maximize.help: Default: on, and off when window title bars are off. On a desktop under 1024 pixels wide or high, new windows fill it anyway.
display.decorations.label: Window title bars
display.decorations.help: Off gives a frameless look. Default: the program decides.
display.dark.label: Dark appearance
display.scheme.label: Colour scheme
display.scheme.help: System follows this device. Once set, System wins over Dark appearance, and Dark appearance wins over Light; left at Default, the viewer decides.
display.theme.label: Theme
display.theme.help: Colours of the viewer's own controls. Default: OC-1.
display.font.label: Font
display.font.help: A font name for the viewer's controls, such as Inter. A name this browser doesn't have falls back to Inter.
err.fontName: Use letters, digits, spaces, _ and - only
display.readonly.label: View only
display.readonly.help: Your keyboard and mouse are not sent. Default: the program decides.
display.keyboard.label: On-screen keyboard
display.keyboard.help: Shows it from the start. Default: on in mobile browsers, off elsewhere. The menu's keyboard button opens it either way.
display.swapKeys.label: Swap Cmd and Ctrl
display.swapKeys.help: Default: on on macOS, off elsewhere.
display.reverseY.label: Reverse vertical scrolling
display.reverseX.label: Reverse horizontal scrolling
display.scrollSpeed.label: Mouse wheel speed
display.touchpadScroll.label: Touchpad scroll speed
display.touchpadScroll.help: 0.2 to 2; lower is less sensitive. Default: 0.85.
display.clipboard.label: Share the clipboard
display.clipboard.help: Copy and paste between this device and the display. Default: on.
display.fileTransfer.label: File transfer
display.fileTransfer.help: Drop files into the display and download from it. Default: on.
display.printing.label: Printing
display.printing.help: Print from the display to this device. Default: on.
display.sound.label: Sound
display.sound.help: Play the display's audio here. Default: the program decides.
display.toolbar.label: Toolbar and menu
display.toolbar.help: The viewer's toolbar and its menu button. Default: on.
display.floatingMenu.label: Floating menu
display.floatingMenu.help: Off also hides the menu button. Default: the program decides.
display.clock.label: Server clock
display.notifications.label: Notifications in the view
display.notifications.help: Programs' notifications show inside the display. Default: the program decides.
display.reconnect.label: Reconnect automatically
display.reconnect.help: After a lost connection. Default: the program decides.
display.titleHoody.label: "Hoody" in the tab title
display.titleId.label: Display number in the tab title
display.vrefresh.label: Refresh rate
display.vrefresh.help: -1 or empty: the viewer measures it, and uses 60 Hz when it can't.
display.offscreen.label: Draw in the background
display.offscreen.help: Turn off if the picture freezes. Default: on in Chrome over https and in Firefox 108 or later; Safari never uses it.
display.suspend.label: Pause in hidden tabs
display.clipFormat.label: Clipboard format
display.audioCodec.label: Audio codec
display.menu.label: Menu button
display.menu.help: An older way to hide the toolbar. Use Toolbar and menu above. Default: on.
display.clipPoll.label: Watch this device's clipboard
display.clipPoll.help: Off stops checking this device's clipboard for changes to send. Default depends on the browser: off in Firefox and in Safari over https.
display.scroll.label: Fast scrolling
display.scroll.help: Sends scrolled areas as copies, which keeps scrolling smooth. Default: the viewer decides.
files.path.folder.label: Folder
files.path.folder.required: Enter a folder for this view
files.path.file.label: File
files.path.file.help: Opens in the editor; changes are saved only when you save.
files.directory.label: Search in
files.directory.required: Enter a folder to search in
files.q.label: Search for
files.q.help: Lists the entries whose names match.
files.sort.label: Sort by
files.order.label: Order
files.theme.label: Theme
files.scheme.label: Light or dark
files.font.label: Font
files.font.help: For the editor and the listing.
files.fontSize.label: Font size
files.parts.label: Show
files.parts.help: Minimal hides them all. Tick one to bring it back.
files.embedBg.label: Transparent background
files.embedBg.help: Lets the Board's background show through. Default: off.
browser.view.status.help: A list of the running browser windows with links to their display and tools.
browser.maximize.label: New windows open maximised
browser.maximize.help: Browser windows fill the display when they open. Default: on.
browser.iframe.label: Show a web page instead
browser.iframe.help: Replaces the browser's display with this page. Leave empty to see the browser. Some browsers block sign-in details inside embedded pages.
code.folder.label: Folder
code.folder.help: Applies when the editor starts. A running editor keeps the folder it started with.
code.folder.required: Enter a folder for this view
code.folderOptional.label: Folder (optional)
code.folderOptional.help: Applies when the editor starts. A running editor keeps the folder it started with.
code.extension.label: Extension
code.locale.label: Language
code.walkthroughs.label: Walkthrough pages
code.walkthroughs.help: Applies when the editor starts. Default: on.
code.pageLoader.label: Loading screen
code.pageLoader.help: While a new editor starts. Default: the program decides.
code.hoodyCode.label: Hoody page integration
code.hoodyCode.help: Syncs the tab title with the editor. Applies when the editor starts. Default: the program decides.
sqlite.table.label: Table (optional)
sqlite.kvTable.label: Store table (optional)
sqlite.db.label: Database
sqlite.db.help: The database file to open. Empty: the program's default.
sqlite.scheme.label: Light or dark
sqlite.embed.label: Compact layout for a tile
notes.userId.label: Your user id in the notebook
notes.userId.help: The id after /notebook/ in a Notes page address. It is your own id in that notebook, not the notebook's id.
notes.userId.required: Enter your user id in the notebook
notes.nodeId.label: Page id
notes.nodeId.help: The last part of a Notes page address.
notes.alias.label: Page alias
notes.alias.help: Opens the page with this alias, or the notebook home when no page has it.
notes.modalNodeId.label: Page shown on top
notes.modalNodeId.help: The id of the page shown in a window over the first one.
notes.modalNodeId.required: Enter the id of the page shown on top
notes.theme.label: Theme
notes.scheme.label: Light or dark
notes.font.label: Font
notes.font.help: The monospace font, for code blocks.
notes.sidebar.label: Show the notebook sidebar
notes.mode.label: Show as
notes.mode.help: View only and Edit both hide the sidebar and show the notebook as a shared page.
err.dots: Use a full path without . or ..
err.locale: Use a language tag such as en or pt-BR
err.notesId: Use 24 to 28 lowercase letters and digits
err.notesAlias: Use lowercase letters, digits, _ and -, up to 48
err.tooLong: Too long to save ({{max}} characters at most)
shell.label: Shell
shell.failed: Could not read what it runs
shell.changing: A shell change is open: see its dialog
